## Comparability caveat

Four of these five carriers are directly comparable — all report on a calendar fiscal year (Jan 1 – Dec 31) [DOC-1]. **Alaska Air Group is not on a fully like-for-like basis**: Alaska closed its acquisition of Hawaiian Holdings on September 18, 2024, and Hawaiian's results are consolidated only from that date forward, contributing $869 million of revenue and a $113 million net loss to the FY2024 consolidated figures [DOC-2]. So Alaska's FY2024 totals blend a full year of standalone Alaska with roughly 3.5 months of Hawaiian, and its profit is depressed relative to what standalone Alaska earned. This does not change the ranking at the top, however.

## FY2024 profitability comparison ($ in millions)

| Airline | Revenue | Operating income | Net income | Op. margin | Net margin |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Delta | $61,643 | $5,995 | $3,457 | 9.7% | 5.6% |
| United | $57,063 | $5,096 | $3,149 | 8.9% | 5.5% |
| American | $54,211 | $2,614 | $846 | 4.8% | 1.6% |
| Southwest | $27,483 | $321 | $465 | 1.2% | 1.7% |
| Alaska | $11,735 | $570 | $395 | 4.9% | 3.4% |

All figures per [DOC-1].

## Conclusion

**Delta Air Lines was the most profitable**, and it leads on every measure:

- Highest net income at $3,457M, ahead of United's $3,149M [DOC-1]
- Highest operating income at $5,995M vs. United's $5,096M [DOC-1]
- Highest operating margin (~9.7%) and the highest net margin (~5.6%, narrowly ahead of United's ~5.5%)

United is a clear second. American, despite being the third-largest by revenue at $54,211M, earned only $846M of net income — less than double Southwest's $465M on roughly twice the revenue [DOC-1]. Southwest is notable in that its net income ($465M) exceeded its operating income ($321M), meaning non-operating items (e.g., interest income) drove its bottom line rather than the core airline operation [DOC-1].

ANSWER: Delta Air Lines — the most profitable in FY2024, with net income of $3,457M and operating income of $5,995M, the highest of the five on both an absolute and margin basis (note: Alaska's FY2024 results include Hawaiian only from September 18, 2024, so Alaska's figures are not fully comparable).
